subject: Joint Success Plan: introductions, roles, and kickoff logistics
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aimee Ross <aimee.ross@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint Success Plan: introductions, roles, and kickoff logistics

Hi Aimee — great to connect yesterday. As discussed, I put together a short draft of a Joint Success Plan (attached) so we can align on scope, evaluation gates, and a close timeline. Goal: firm up a 60–90 day evaluation with clear success metrics and a staged rollout plan if the PoC meets those gates.

Proposed next steps:
- Kickoff call (30–45m) to introduce stakeholders, confirm roles, and finalize the evaluation checklist
- Agree on evaluation artifacts and who will own each deliverable
- Lock a targeted completion date for the PoC so we can model dedicated capacity if you proceed

Availability I can open for the kickoff: Mon 6/16 10:00–11:00 PT, Tue 6/17 14:00–15:00 PT, Wed 6/18 09:00–10:00 PT. If none of those work, tell me 2 windows that do and I’ll send a hold.

Attendees we suggest from Redwood: me (Eng + GTM lead), Marissa Cole (Customer Success, evaluation plan & metrics), Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer, integration + test plan), Karthik Iyer (Security & compliance lead — if you want SSO/KMS conversation).

Please see the attached: Clearwater_MAP_Draft_20250611.pdf (proposed milestones and owners) and a short kickoff agenda draft. Could you confirm who from Clearwater should attend (technical lead, procurement, and one executive sponsor)? Also let us know any compliance artifacts you want referenced during the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

—
Lauren Bishop
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Clearwater_MAP_Draft_20250611.pdf (PDF, 220KB); Kickoff_Agenda_20250612.docx (DOCX, 14KB)
From: Aimee Ross <aimee.ross@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@clearwaterhealth.com>, Clearwater Health Procurement <procurement@clearwaterhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint Success Plan: introductions, roles, and kickoff logistics

Hi Lauren — thanks for the materials and the clear plan. The draft looks good at a high level.

We can do Tue 6/17 14:00 PT — that works best for our team. I’m looping in Daniel (technical lead) and procurement so they’re aware; Daniel will bring the integration questions. Our exec sponsor (CMO) is tentatively available but would prefer to join the first 20m only.

Two quick asks before the call:
1) Can you include a Zoom link and calendar hold?
2) We'll need a short list of the specific evaluation datasets and an example test case so our infra team can confirm resource needs ahead of time.

Best,
Aimee
Senior Director, Digital Programs
Clearwater Health
Aimee.Ross@clearwaterhealth.com

Thanks — holding Tue 17 Jun 2025 14:00–14:45 PT for the kickoff. Zoom + calendar invite below. I also attached a proposed agenda document and a one-pager describing the evaluation artifacts we typically ask teams to provide.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=example
Passcode: CWkick2025
Calendar invite: Sent (please accept so we have final headcount).

Agenda (high level)
- 0–5m: Introductions & success criteria (executive sponsor in first 20m)
- 5–20m: Scope walk-through & evaluation checklist (who owns each test)
- 20–35m: Integration ops (data, SSO, infra needs) — Dev will cover this
- 35–45m: Next steps, timeline, procurement checklist (procurement team to confirm terms)

Attachments: Kickoff_Agenda_20250612.docx; eval-test-dataset-README.txt

Looking forward to it.

—
Lauren

On the logistics note: Marissa, can you own the evaluation success metrics doc and invite the CSM prep session next week? Dev — can you prepare a short slide on integration prerequisites and the test harness we’ll use? Karthik, please be on for the compliance questions around SSO/KMS.
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint Success Plan: introductions, roles, and kickoff logistics (internal)

Lauren — I’ll take the integration slide and bring an example test harness. I uploaded a small README and the test dataset pointers we typically share: eval-test-dataset-README.txt (listed in attachments).

Notes for the kickoff:
- Test harness: local container + sample JSON inputs (we'll provide container image and the harness script)
- Required access: API key for Redwood staging, and a set of representative sample records (anonymized) — ask Clearwater infra to confirm export format (JSONL preferred)
- Time estimate for basic integration: 2–3 business days for data handoff + one day for smoke runs

I’ll also draft a one-slide runbook for the demo so the exec sponsor sees a clear staging/demo plan.

—Dev
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

All confirmed on our side for Tue 6/17 14:00 PT. Attendees: Aimee Ross (Digital Programs), Daniel Park (Tech Lead), Sharon Li (Procurement), and our CMO will join the first 20 minutes as available.

One question for the kickoff: will you be able to cover high-level data handling and SOC2 scope? Procurement asked if you can point to SOC2 evidence or an auditor contact during the call. If you can share a short pointer (or the relevant doc) ahead of time, that would accelerate our procurement review.

I'll accept the calendar invite and share a calendar event with our team. See you Tuesday.

Best,
Aimee
